subject: Access controls: SAML assertion timing, SCIM delta window, and role-owner map for SIG attestation
messages:
From: Jason Smith <j.smith@midwestops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@midwestops.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Hi Karthik,

We're starting the SIG questionnaire review and procurement needs a concise package from Redwood covering access controls. Can you help with the following items for our auditors (ClaritySec) by Monday 2025-06-23?

- A sample of raw SAML assertions (full XML with signature blocks removed if needed) for two test users and one service account, indicating NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter timestamps.
- A SCIM delta export covering a 30-day window (we typically look for proof of SCIM deltas and object versioning).
- A role-owner map showing which internal teams own each role (role id -> owner email), and confirmation that roles are scoped to least privilege.
- Notes on whether the SAML assertions include eduPersonPrincipalName or a stable identifier we can map to SCIM.

If there are standard redaction steps you prefer (hashing emails, removing PII fields), tell us and we'll accept the sanitized form. ClaritySec will use this to validate your control implementation and the SIG matrix.

Thanks,
Jason
Jason Smith
Senior Procurement Manager
Midwest Operations
procure@midwestops.com
(312) 555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jason Smith <j.smith@midwestops.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ClaritySec Audit <auditor@claritysec.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Jason — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a sanitized package that meets the SIG and SOC 2 reviewers' needs. Quick confirmations and our proposed deliverables/timeline: 

1) Deliverables we will provide:
   - saml-assertions-sample.csv (CSV with assertion_id, subject_id_hash, not_before_utc, not_on_or_after_utc, attributes_summary) and separate XML stubs for two test users (full assertion text, signatures removed).
   - scim-delta-20250515-20250615.zip (SCIM change log + a short runbook to reproduce the export).
   - role-owner-map-2025-05.csv (role_id, role_name, owner_team, owner_contact, least_privilege_notes).
   - short README.md describing redaction/hashing method and attribute mapping (SAML->SCIM).

2) Redaction policy: we will hash user emails with SHA-256 and keep stable identifiers (subject hashes) so ClaritySec can correlate SAML and SCIM without PII. Service accounts will be flagged; if you need full unhashed service-account IDs for a small set, we can provide them via secure transfer.

3) Timeline: initial package by 2025-06-20 EOD PDT; fully signed assertion XMLs delivered by 2025-06-22 if needed for attribute-mapping checks. Let us know if you need an earlier snapshot.

4) Questions for you:
   - Confirm whether you need service-account full identifiers (yes/no).
   - Which attribute do you prefer we map as the canonical identifier (email, eduPersonPrincipalName, or subject hash)?

I'll loop in Priyom for the exports and Laura for audit packaging.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jason Smith <j.smith@midwestops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ClaritySec Audit <auditor@claritysec.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 10:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jason — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a sanitized package that meets the SIG and SOC 2 reviewers' needs.

Following up with the technical pack we'll produce:

- scim-delta-20250515-20250615.zip: contains change events (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE) with timestamps, object versions, and a small script (export_replay.sh) showing how we generated the delta from our provisioning logs.
- saml-assertions-sample.csv: spreadsheet with 3 rows (two human test users + one SA). We'll also attach two XML files: saml-userA.xml and saml-userB.xml (signatures removed).
- role-owner-map-2025-05.csv: point-in-time snapshot pulled 2025-05-31 covering all roles and owner_contact fields. For least-privilege notes we'll add a short column with justification and last-reviewed date.

Notes/assumptions:
- SCIM window: May 15 2025 00:00 UTC -> Jun 15 2025 23:59 UTC (we used UTC for consistency).
- Attribute mapping: by default we'll map to a stable subject hash and include original attribute names (email, displayName, roles) in the README. If you prefer eduPersonPrincipalName as canonical, we can add it for matched accounts.
- Service accounts: by default service accounts are included but masked. If you request unhashed service-account IDs, please confirm a secure transfer method (we prefer an SFTP or a signed DocuSign access token).

Attachments (stubs): saml-assertions-sample.csv, saml-userA.xml, saml-userB.xml, scim-delta-20250515-20250615.zip, role-owner-map-2025-05.csv

I'll upload the archive to the shared drive and paste a link once the upload completes.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Platform Engineer, Identity
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
From: auditor@claritysec.com <auditor@claritysec.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Smith <j.smith@midwestops.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts needed

Karthik / Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the plan. A few clarifications from the audit side before we start validation: 

- For the SAML XMLs we do need the NotBefore and NotOnOrAfter timestamps in UTC and prefer the full assertion text (signature blocks may be stripped but include the Assertion element and attribute statements).
- In addition to the role-owner map CSV, please provide a short mapping file that ties SAML attribute names to internal role IDs (example: eduPersonEntitlement -> role_id 1023). That helps us validate entitlement translation.
- For SCIM deltas, include the first and last sequence numbers for the exported window so we can verify no gaps.
- If service accounts remain masked, please include a separate index file listing masked_id -> service_account_type so we understand functional ownership.

We are fine with the 2025-06-20 EOD delivery for the sanitized package; for any unhashed service-account identifiers we'll request a secure channel.

Thanks and looking forward to the upload link.

Regards,
Hannah Park
Lead Auditor, ClaritySec
auditor@claritysec.com
